title: 夺回营地

files.purpose: 序章受损关闭营地门，未通电
同机位修好门板、暖灯与旗帜，营地恢复

qa.visual: Inspected originals, damaged final and paired 384x640 preview. Matched gate placement, clean central 3-lane space, no actors/enemies/UI/text baked in.
qa.pixel: Final PNGs use Format24bppRgb; opaque RGB, no alpha.
qa.comparison: Gate anchors closely match; minor generated surface texture differences remain. Prefer short whole-scene crossfade at progression transition, not rapidly alternating states.
qa.optionalLights: Not produced. Use supplied whole-state backgrounds.

usageConstraints: Keep native 3:5 framing; contain or intentional centered crop only.
Gate and towers occupy roughly y=0..300. Do not place key combat entities against detailed gate area.
Visual repair only; collision, heroes, enemies, projectiles and text must remain runtime layers.
